recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce ImagingStudy.interpreter for this issue; any future work should be handled under the unresolved search-design issue FHIR-19688 or a new work-group decision if examples are deemed necessary.
issue_request: FHIR-19683 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested PractitionerRole as a possible reference for ImagingStudy.referrer and ImagingStudy.interpreter, updates to mappings and examples, referrer/interpreter search parameters, and a Zulip question about querying through PractitionerRole.
initial_application: The request was applied historically in commit 710e005513, which changed the ImagingStudy spreadsheet referrer and interpreter types from Reference(Practitioner) to Reference(Practitioner|PractitionerRole) and added referrer/interpreter search parameter rows. Later source rework carried those definitions into the current XML source files.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has PractitionerRole on ImagingStudy.referrer and ImagingStudy.series.performer.actor, and has referrer and performer reference search parameters. Later Published issue FHIR-38922 removed ImagingStudy.interpreter and its search parameter, so that part of FHIR-19683 is now superseded. The broader indirect Practitioner search question was split into FHIR-19688, which remains unresolved.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is required because the current remaining ImagingStudy references and search parameters already reflect the applicable part of FHIR-19683, while re-adding interpreter would conflict with FHIR-38922. Adding an optional PractitionerRole example would not change current conformance or correct misleading source.
